questions.stem: How is the bacterial cell wall different from the plant cell wall?

options.text: Both are made of exactly the same material
Bacterial cell walls are made of peptidoglycan; plant cell walls are made of cellulose
Bacterial cell walls are made of cellulose; plant cell walls are made of protein
Plant cells have cell walls but bacterial cells do not

questions.explanation: Bacterial cell walls are made of peptidoglycan, while plant cell walls are made of cellulose. This is an important difference because some antibiotics, like penicillin, work by targeting peptidoglycan synthesis.
